verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for an image-processing CLI and library, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ImageMagick ships one: it offers a scripting-first CLI and language bindings, and its llms.txt file is documentation for external AI tools, not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
